NOTHING IN THE RUNNING GAME SELECTS FROM IT. *** CORRECTION vs the first revision of this note and of the file header (Security review 2026-09-07): the claim that '2026-08-08-leaderboards.sql reads from public.game_saves inside a SECURITY DEFINER body' is FALSE OF THE LIVE DATABASE and must not be repeated. The string does exist at 2026-08-08-leaderboards.sql:145, but that is the ORIGINAL leaderboard_ranked matview body, which 2026-08-18-leaderboard-server-source.sql DROPS and rebuilds over player_state + player_skills exactly because the snapshot blob was client-authored; that file's S6(a) reads pg_depend and REFUSES to install unless leaderboard_ranked has ZERO dependency on game_saves, with a positive control that it does depend on player_state. Live hr_leaderboard__ungated contains zero game_saves references. And a SECURITY DEFINER body is unaffected by role grants in any case, so the sentence could never have been a reason to keep a grant on `authenticated` even had it been true. Separately, 2026-08-08-leaderboards.sql must NOT be re-run against a live database (see its own note: it re-opens the F5 matview dump and overwrites the A9 rate-gate wrapper). *** DELETE IS NOW TAKEN (Security GO-WITH-CHANGES; the first revision left it MEASURED-OPEN): Supabase's default privileges give `authenticated` DELETE on a public table, so a signed-in browser could hand-roll a PostgREST call and delete its OWN archived pre-cutover save (RLS scopes it to auth.uid()). That single 2026-08-23 archived row is the ONLY forensic copy of that account's pre-cutover state, including any FORGED state - and the restore-census ALREADY classifies restoring these rows as FORBIDDEN, so the row can never be handed back to a player and its entire remaining value is as EVIDENCE. Leaving DELETE reachable preserved no capability a player wants, only the ability to erase evidence of one's own forgery with no ledger row. Revoking it REMOVES a way to destroy retained data; it adds no retention obligation and blocks nothing - the drop slice still drops the table as the owner, and the rollback restores the grant in one statement. Does NOT drop the table, delete a row or touch RLS - those rows are real players' pre-cutover progress and the table DROP is a later slice. FOR THE CENSUS: game_saves keeps its CURRENT classification now; at the DROP slice its class becomes `retire`. Deliberately NOT pre-applied in this commit - the census must describe the database that exists. WHY: b515 retired the b353 kill switch (`localStorage['hr:serverAccrual']='off'`), whose off position was a divergent single-device local game that upserted the client-authored save blob INTO THIS TABLE (src/net/sync.js snapshotIfDue) and was silently discarded on flip-back - a client-authored fallback CLAUDE.md S1 forbids. The client code is deleted; this closes the door behind it so the blob cannot return through a stale build or a hand-rolled PostgREST call. NOT AN EXPLOIT FIX and must not be reported as one: RLS already scoped every write to the forger's own row, so this removes a CAPABILITY, not a hole. BLAST RADIUS: a player on a pre-b515 build gets a 401/403 on that upsert - correct (their authority state is server-side and their residue rides hr_put_client_state, a SECURITY DEFINER RPC this does not touch) but real, so APPLY WITH OR AFTER the b515 client push, never long before it. Both DO blocks and the S4 self-check are guarded on pg_roles so the repo chain still replays on PGlite, where `authenticated`/`anon` do not exist - and S4 says out loud that it did not assert there rather than passing silently. Installs no object, restates no function body, joins no derivation chain, moves no live-hash pin, needs no Edge redeploy. Idempotent; S4 proves the post-state in TWO independent readings - the grant catalogue (information_schema.role_table_grants) AND has_table_privilege, which follows role membership and PUBLIC and so catches a capability inherited rather than granted directly: no authenticated INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, exactly one SELECT grant with the capability really present, no anon writes, RLS still ON. ROLLBACK: `grant insert, update, delete on public.game_saves to authenticated;` (all three - pasting only insert+update would silently leave DELETE revoked and report success).
